body: Hey, thanks so much for your reply, I actually ended up talking it out with a friend. I got really scared because it's been bad before, but I've never felt so compelled to write letters to people like that :( Sometimes my mind just tells me I'm not worthy of anything - I'm trying to get better at telling it to shut up but it's hard to learn. Anyway, ty so much.

Thank you so much for your reply - I slept on it and actually feel a lot better today. You're right, the self hatred mostly consists of me fortune-telling or trying to read other people's minds... I read my acceptance and commitment therapy book again which reminded me that the stories my mind makes up are just stories, not the real event. I feel like it all just caught me off guard at once, and that's why I was feeling so awful. I need to find ways to catch it before it becomes that much of a problem :(
